title: Do not weaken a failing verification to make a change pass
prohibited_change: Removing, skipping, or weakening a verification solely to make a change pass.
applicability: The changed verification protects behavior that remains in scope.
exceptions: The protected behavior was intentionally removed and the acceptance contract was explicitly updated by an authorized owner.
rationale: A green result produced by weakening the verifier does not demonstrate a safer implementation.

title: Do not convert unknown or not-evaluated state into pass or ready
prohibited_change: Treating unknown, missing, or not-evaluated evidence as pass, ready, complete, or approved.
applicability: Readiness or validation depends on evidence that is still missing or not evaluated.
exceptions: A separate explicit incomplete state is used and positive approval remains impossible until evidence is evaluated.
rationale: Presence of a record is not proof that the underlying condition was evaluated.

title: Avoid broad exception handling that hides validation failure
prohibited_change: Adding a broad catch-all path that converts validation failure into success or silent continuation.
applicability: The exception path can suppress a validation failure without an equivalent explicit failure signal.
exceptions: The catch-all path re-raises or returns an explicit failure state that downstream logic cannot treat as success.
rationale: This pattern is plausible but remains candidate-only until verified local evidence justifies stronger enforcement.
